notes: The list of Kreisler's original works and 'classical manuscript' pastiches is essentially complete. The only clear gap is a set entry for the three Alt-Wiener Tanzweisen, which are often performed and recorded together. His many transcriptions of other composers (Dvořák, Albéniz, Granados, Falla, Paganini, Rimsky-Korsakov and others) are omitted on purpose because they belong under the original composers; cadenzas and the String Quartet are out of scope.
